title: Correct orientation automatically
statement: Correct display orientation for large photo collections with particular strength on selfie-heavy libraries.
target: Accepted decisions meet the release precision target on the governed evaluation corpus.

title: Protect originals and metadata
statement: Prevent silent data loss, corruption, avoidable recompression, or metadata damage.
target: Destructive fault-injection and metadata round-trip gates pass before in-place mode ships.

title: Operate locally and privately
statement: Perform analysis and transformation offline without uploading photographs or creating identity profiles.
target: Network-isolation tests pass; no biometric identity feature or default telemetry exists.

title: Make automation auditable
statement: Explain every decision with stable evidence, confidence, policy, model, and file provenance.
target: Every planned action has a schema-valid record and can be reproduced from the job manifest.

title: Scale predictably
statement: Process collections from one image to hundreds of thousands without unbounded memory growth or fragile shell behavior.
target: Soak, cancellation, restart, and bounded-resource benchmarks pass.

title: Support professional operations
statement: Provide stable CLI contracts, machine-readable output, deterministic exit codes, resumable jobs, review queues, and diagnostics.
target: CLI contract and compatibility tests pass across supported Windows environments.

title: Remain maintainable and extensible
statement: Separate codecs, metadata, inference, policy, persistence, and presentation behind tested contracts.
target: Architecture conformance tests prevent forbidden dependencies and substitute test doubles at each port.

title: Earn trust through abstention
statement: Prefer REVIEW or NO-OP over an uncertain or unsafe rotation.
target: False-rotation ceiling is met before optimizing coverage.

title: Discover inputs
statement: Recursively discover supported files from files, directories, response files, and standard input while applying deterministic include/exclude rules.

title: Inspect capabilities
statement: Provide `upright doctor` and `upright inspect` to report codecs, model/runtime availability, metadata, orientation transforms, filesystem constraints, and likely actions without writing files.

title: Read EXIF orientation
statement: Read EXIF Orientation values 1–8, including mirrored cases, and distinguish stored-pixel geometry from intended display geometry.

title: Analyze four upright candidates
statement: Evaluate 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270° additional rotations after applying the metadata display transform to an analysis representation.

title: Detect and score faces
statement: Use local face detection and five-point landmarks to derive orientation evidence without performing face recognition.

title: Calibrate confidence and abstain
statement: Convert evidence into calibrated decision probabilities and choose REVIEW when score, margin, evidence, or safety rules are not satisfied.

title: Create immutable plans
statement: The scan phase shall create a durable immutable plan containing file identity, fingerprints, evidence, selected action, policy version, model identity, and expected output.

title: Separate analysis and apply
statement: Analysis is read-only; apply consumes a plan and refuses stale, changed, missing, or policy-incompatible inputs.

title: Safe-copy output
statement: Default operation shall write corrected files to a separate output root while preserving relative paths and resolving collisions deterministically.

title: Guarded in-place output
statement: In-place changes require explicit acknowledgement, verified backups, write-ahead journal entries, same-volume staging, independent verification, and atomic replacement.

title: Lossless JPEG transform
statement: For 90-degree JPEG rotations, prefer DCT-domain lossless transforms and apply an explicit policy to non-transformable MCU edge cases.

title: Normalize orientation metadata
statement: After successful physical normalization, set orientation metadata to 1 and preserve governed metadata according to the active policy.

title: Verify outputs independently
statement: Reopen every output through an independent read path and verify decodability, dimensions, orientation state, expected digest class, and required metadata before commit.

title: Resume interrupted jobs
statement: Persist checkpoints so scan, apply, verify, and undo can resume idempotently after cancellation, process termination, or reboot.

title: Undo in-place changes
statement: Restore verified backups only when current state matches the journal's expected post-apply state, otherwise abstain and report a conflict.

title: Review uncertain items
statement: Provide list, show, decide, export, and import operations for REVIEW items, including thumbnails and evidence without requiring a graphical shell.

title: Human and machine output
statement: Support human-readable output plus schema-versioned JSON and JSON Lines, keeping machine stdout pure and progress/diagnostics on stderr.

title: Stable exit codes
statement: Return documented, composable exit codes for success, review required, partial completion, invalid arguments/configuration, capability failure, stale plan, verification failure, and internal error.

title: Validate configuration
statement: Load configuration with deterministic precedence and validate it against a versioned JSON Schema before work begins.

title: Model lifecycle
statement: List, install, verify, activate, quarantine, and remove signed or digest-pinned model bundles using versioned manifests and rollback-safe activation.

title: Capability-gated formats
statement: Support JPEG and PNG at baseline and expose HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, and WebP only when decode, encode, metadata, and transform capabilities are verified.

title: Bounded concurrency
statement: Run discovery, decode, inference, transform, and verification through bounded stages with backpressure, cancellation, and configurable resource limits.

title: Audit and reporting
statement: Produce per-file events, aggregate summaries, provenance, timings, warnings, and reproducibility metadata without logging image content by default.

title: Sequence consensus
statement: Optionally use bounded temporal or burst-group consensus as a tie-breaker, never as the sole basis for a high-confidence decision.

title: Scene fallback
statement: Allow a compact local scene-orientation model as a gated fallback for no-face images only after evaluation proves incremental value without violating precision.

title: Benchmark command
statement: Provide a benchmark command for representative decode, inference, transform, metadata, and end-to-end workloads, emitting environment and version metadata.

title: Shell completion and response files
statement: Generate PowerShell completion and accept UTF-8 response files for robust automation with long input lists.

title: Job integrity tools
statement: List, inspect, validate, prune, and integrity-check jobs without applying image changes.

title: Reliability
statement: No source file may be deleted, truncated, or replaced before a verified output and durable journal state exist.
target: 100% in fault-injection suite

title: Reliability
statement: All mutating operations are idempotent or explicitly conflict-detecting under replay.
target: All replay scenarios pass

title: Reliability
statement: The application shall detect stale plans using file identity and content fingerprints before apply.
target: Zero undetected mutations in test matrix

title: Reliability
statement: A crash at any injected persistence boundary shall leave a recoverable, diagnosable state.
target: 100% crash-point recovery cases pass

title: ML quality
statement: Precision is the primary release metric; coverage may not be increased by weakening the false-rotation ceiling.
target: Accepted selfie precision ≥99.5% on governed corpus

title: ML quality
statement: Already-upright photos accepted for automation shall rarely be rotated incorrectly.
target: False rotation ≤0.1% on governed upright subset

title: ML quality
statement: Target accepted-decision coverage only after precision targets are met.
target: Should target ≥85% selfie coverage

title: ML quality
statement: Calibration shall be measured by orientation-, device-, demographic-, lighting-, and occlusion-aware slices.
target: No critical slice violates release ceiling without documented block/mitigation

title: Performance
statement: Memory usage shall be bounded independently of collection size.
target: Configurable ceiling; default working set target ≤1.5 GB on reference host

title: Performance
statement: Analysis shall avoid full-resolution decode when a bounded thumbnail is sufficient.
target: At least 95% of analyzed files use bounded decode path

title: Performance
statement: The pipeline shall keep CPU, GPU, storage, and metadata subprocess work bounded and observable.
target: No unbounded queue; stage metrics emitted

title: Performance
statement: Cold-start and single-file inspection shall remain practical on supported hardware.
target: Doctor <3 s and inspect p95 <2 s on reference host, excluding first model install

title: Security
statement: Treat image files, metadata, model bundles, configuration, and job imports as untrusted input.
target: Threat-model controls and negative tests complete

title: Security
statement: Third-party binaries and models shall be version-pinned, digest-verified, inventoried, and license-reviewed.
target: 100% production artifacts in SBOM and dependency register

title: Security
statement: No arbitrary in-process third-party plugin loading in v1.
target: Plugin boundary policy enforced by architecture tests

title: Privacy
statement: Core operation shall require no network access and shall not upload image pixels or metadata.
target: Network-denied end-to-end tests pass

title: Privacy
statement: No face recognition, identity embeddings, or cross-file identity profiles may be created.
target: Design and binary review confirm absence

title: Privacy
statement: Telemetry is disabled by default; diagnostic bundles redact paths unless explicitly requested.
target: Privacy review and golden diagnostics pass

title: CLI UX
statement: Destructive behavior shall require explicit, non-ambiguous flags and shall never be triggered by defaults.
target: CLI golden tests cover all destructive paths

title: CLI UX
statement: Human output shall be concise and actionable; machine output shall be stable, complete, and free of decoration.
target: Usability review plus schema/stream tests pass

title: Compatibility
statement: Primary release target is supported Windows 11 x64 with NTFS; behavior on ReFS, network shares, cloud placeholders, and removable media is capability-gated.
target: Published compatibility matrix backed by tests

title: Compatibility
statement: Paths shall support Unicode and Windows long-path semantics without lossy normalization.
target: Path conformance matrix passes

title: Fidelity
statement: Governed metadata preservation shall be field-aware and validated, not implemented as an unqualified byte-copy promise.
target: Metadata corpus round-trip policy passes

title: Fidelity
statement: JPEGs shall not be recompressed when a safe DCT-domain rotation is possible.
target: Coefficient or lossless-equivalence checks pass

title: Maintainability
statement: Domain policy shall not depend directly on CLI, storage engine, model runtime, or native codec implementation.
target: Architecture conformance tests pass

title: Maintainability
statement: All externally consumed schemas and exit codes shall be versioned with compatibility policy.
target: Contract compatibility suite passes

title: Supportability
statement: Every job shall expose correlation IDs, stage timings, warnings, failure categories, runtime/model versions, and reproducibility data.
target: Support bundle completeness test passes

title: Supportability
statement: Logs shall remain bounded through rotation/retention and shall not include image bytes.
target: Soak and privacy tests pass

statement: Given mixed files/directories and filters, discovery returns the same canonical ordered set across repeated runs.
Loops, inaccessible paths, reparse points, aliases, and duplicate identities are handled according to policy without infinite traversal.
`doctor --json` emits a schema-valid capability report and performs no source writes.
`inspect` explains stored dimensions, EXIF transform, candidate evidence, proposed action, and blockers for one file.
Golden images for all EXIF Orientation values 1–8 render to the same intended upright view.
Candidate generation composes EXIF display transforms before additional rotational hypotheses.
Candidate scoring is deterministic for a pinned model, runtime, policy, and input.
Face detections expose bounding boxes, confidence, and five landmarks for each candidate.
No persisted artifact contains an identity embedding or cross-file face identifier.
Automation requires configured score, top-two margin, and minimum-evidence gates.
Ambiguous, no-face, contradictory multi-face, or out-of-distribution cases become REVIEW rather than forced rotations.
A job plan validates against its schema and records tool, policy, model, runtime, and source fingerprints.
Once sealed, plan rows cannot be edited through normal commands; review overrides are append-only decisions.
`scan` creates no image output and does not modify source timestamps, data streams, or metadata.
`apply` refuses a source changed after scan and emits a stable stale-plan result.
Safe-copy mode preserves relative paths and never overwrites an unrelated existing destination.
Collision behavior is deterministic, logged, and configurable as error, skip, or content-aware rename.
In-place mode cannot begin without explicit acknowledgement and a writable verified backup target.
Fault injection before atomic replacement leaves the source unchanged and a recoverable journal.
Fault injection after replacement but before final checkpoint is reconciled safely on restart.
Eligible JPEG rotations use the DCT-domain path without generation loss.
Non-MCU-aligned JPEG behavior follows the selected abort/reencode/trim/preserve-partial policy and is never silent.
Successful normalization writes display-equivalent upright pixels and sets orientation metadata to 1.
Required metadata fields pass the device/format round-trip corpus under the active preservation policy.
Verification reopens output and rejects decode failure, wrong dimensions, wrong orientation, or missing required metadata.
A verification failure prevents commit or triggers recovery without deleting the last known-good source.
Cancellation produces a resumable state and a documented partial-completion exit code.
Replaying a completed operation does not duplicate output or corrupt journal state.
Undo restores a byte-verified backup when the current file matches the expected applied state.
Undo refuses and reports conflict when the current file was independently changed.
Review decisions can be exported, edited with documented values, imported, validated, and appended to the job.
Review thumbnails are orientation-labeled, bounded in size, and stored only when explicitly enabled.
`--json` emits one schema-valid document; `--jsonl` emits independently parseable event lines.
With machine output selected, stdout contains no progress bars, ANSI styling, or unsolicited prose.
All documented result classes map to stable exit codes tested on Windows PowerShell and cmd.exe.
Configuration precedence is CLI > environment > explicit file > user file > defaults.
Unknown or invalid configuration fields fail before file processing unless forward-compatible mode is explicitly selected.
A model bundle with wrong digest, unsupported schema, or incompatible runtime is quarantined and never activated.
Model activation is atomic and rollback restores the prior verified model.
Format support is reported per operation; unsupported write/metadata combinations fail during planning rather than mid-commit.
Configured queue and worker limits bound memory under a 100,000-file synthetic workload.
Ctrl+C first requests graceful cancellation; a second interrupt terminates promptly with durable state.
Every file has a terminal event with action, result, reason code, timings, and provenance.
Default logs contain no image bytes and path redaction is available for support bundles.
Sequence consensus can break a bounded tie but cannot override hard safety or evidence gates.
Scene fallback remains disabled unless its evaluation report demonstrates statistically supported net benefit.
Benchmark output records hardware, OS, runtime, model, configuration, corpus descriptor, throughput, latency, and memory.
Generated PowerShell completion and UTF-8 response files handle spaces, Unicode, and long paths.
Job integrity detects missing artifacts, invalid schema, digest mismatch, illegal state transition, and orphaned temporary files.
Prune defaults to dry-run and cannot remove jobs with pending recovery or undo retention.
